organiser_ruling_rationale: Per organiser policy v2.1 Section 3.3: if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $4.50 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change (1.0x to 1.5x). Surgeable subtotal $9.00 * (1.5 - 1.0) = $4.50. Booking fee is surge-exempt.
